guard: the ACP agent keeps each protocol promise its docs make: a probe leaves no trace, a turn's updates and closed tool calls reach the client before the prompt answers, sign-in is offered and reported only where it applies, list and load show the right runs, later prompts are typed into the seat, end when it stops working and fail with the manager's reason when it refuses them, a cancel interrupts the seat and answers cancelled, also when the interrupt is refused or the session is deleted, and the frame mapping neither repeats nor misreports a seat's events
why: Each mutation is a plausible one-line regression in the protocol layer or the frame mapping. The smokes import src directly, so no build runs between the mutation and the suite.

mutations.name: a probe's delete writes to the hidden store
mutations.expectRed: deleting a session that never spawned hides nothing

mutations.name: frames that beat the spawn reply are dropped
mutations.find: for (const frame of held?.frames ?? []) deliver(session, frame);
mutations.expectRed: frames published before the spawn reply still reach the client

mutations.name: a turn answers with its tool calls left open
mutations.expectRed: a tool call left open is closed before the prompt answers

mutations.name: terminal sign-in offered to every client
mutations.expectRed: a client that runs no terminal is offered no sign-in

mutations.name: a sign-in failure reported as an internal error
mutations.find: throw e instanceof SignInRequired ? RequestError.authRequired(undefined, e.message) : RequestError.internalError(undefined, e.message);
mutations.expectRed: a space that needs a sign-in fails session/new with -32000

mutations.name: list compares folders without resolving symlinks
mutations.expectRed: session/list matches the folder through a symlink

mutations.name: list ignores hidden runs
mutations.expectRed: a hidden run is not listed

mutations.name: a replay is not marked as replay
mutations.find: for (const update of updates) await send(session, update, true);
mutations.replace: for (const update of updates) await send(session, update);
mutations.expectRed: session/load replays before it answers, marked as replay

mutations.name: the channel choice is not passed to the spawn
mutations.expectRed: it spawns in the session's folder with the prompt and the chosen options

mutations.name: a failed run answers as a finished turn
mutations.expectRed: a failed run fails the prompt with the seat's message

mutations.name: applications without an event plane are offered
mutations.expectRed: applications without an event plane are not offered

mutations.name: a variant carries to a model that lacks it
mutations.find: return variantsOf(offer, next).includes(selection.variant) ? next : { ...next, variant: DEFAULT_VARIANT };
mutations.expectRed: a variant does not carry to a model that lacks it

mutations.name: a frame maps again when a history read and the live tap overlap
mutations.expectRed: a frame already mapped maps to nothing

mutations.name: a failed tool call shows as completed
mutations.expectRed: the result marker ends the call as failed when it says so

mutations.name: RUN_ERROR loses the seat's message
mutations.expectRed: RUN_ERROR ends the frame's run with the seat's message

mutations.name: a later prompt answers while its run is still open
mutations.expectRed: a later prompt answers only after the runs it started ended

mutations.name: a later prompt the seat never starts on waits forever
mutations.expectRed: a later prompt the seat does not start on answers, and says so

mutations.name: a cancel is ignored
mutations.expectRed: a cancel interrupts the seat through its manager

mutations.name: a cancelled turn whose run errors fails instead of answering cancelled
mutations.find: fail: (error) => turn.cancelled !== undefined ? finish("failed", () => resolve("cancelled")) : finish("failed", () => reject(RequestError.internalError(undefined, error.message))),
mutations.expectRed: a cancelled prompt answers cancelled when the interrupted run ends as an error

mutations.name: a cancel that beats the spawn reply is dropped
mutations.expectRed: a cancel that beats the spawn reply interrupts once the seat exists

mutations.name: a refused interrupt is silent
mutations.find:
void send(session, { sessionUpdate: "agent_message_chunk", content: { type: "text", text: `Could not stop ${seat.name}: ${e.message}. It keeps working on the mesh.` } })
            .catch((err: Error) => options.log(`session ${session.id}: update not sent: ${err.message}`));
mutations.expectRed: a refused interrupt is said in the thread

mutations.name: a refused prompt answers as a finished turn
mutations.expectRed: a prompt the manager refuses to type fails with its reason

mutations.name: a later prompt's runs are counted from after the input reply
mutations.expectRed: a run that ends before the input reply still answers the later prompt

mutations.name: a refused interrupt keeps the cancelled prompt running
mutations.expectRed: a refused interrupt still answers the prompt cancelled

mutations.name: a deleted session leaves its prompt unanswered
mutations.expectRed: deleting a session answers its running prompt cancelled and leaves the seat running

mutations.name: a machine switch keeps choices the new manager lacks
mutations.expectRed: a persona the chosen machine lacks returns to the default

mutations.name: a spawn that returns after a delete binds the deleted session
mutations.expectRed: a delete during the first spawn answers once its seat is hidden, and sends that seat nowhere
